verdict.rationale: Reclaim's scheduling links (docs-2, docs-12, docs-17, docs-29) support sharing availability and auto-rescheduling around booked events, but the evidence pack shows no mention of multiple distinct event types, per-event custom durations, custom questions/intake forms, or per-event confirmation rules — features common in dedicated booking tools. missing for 10: multiple event-type configuration, custom durations per type, location settings per event, custom intake questions, confirmation/approval rules, and any independent corroboration of these specifics.
